info.title: Atoll Encrypted Chat API
info.description: OpenAPI specification for the Atoll server API. Derived from code annotations. Source of truth remains Server Spec v3.0.4.

post.description: Reads EXTENSION_PROXY_DENY_DOMAINS and EXTENSION_PROXY_DENY_DOMAINS_PATH, validates, and performs an atomic swap. On error, previous blocklist remains in effect and 400 is returned. See §8.3.2.

400.description: Blocklist file missing or load failed

get.description: Fetches Key Transparency log statistics including total entries and leaf timestamps. See §8.3.

post.description: Triggers immediate generation and signing of a Key Transparency log Merkle tree snapshot. Reuses the same snapshot schema as public KT snapshot endpoint. See §8.3.

200.description: Key Transparency snapshot triggered and generated successfully

post.description: Reloads model manifest with mode-dependent atomic swap semantics. On validation/fetch failure, previous models remain in effect and error is returned. See §8.3 and §5.27.

502.description: Failed to fetch external model manifest

post.description: Resamples the server username OPRF key. WARNING: CATASTROPHIC OPERATOR OPERATION. Invalidates all existing username tokens and forces full user re-registration. See §8.3 and §5.8.

get.description: Fetches the list of active sessions for a room. Read-only variant for admin visibility. See §8.3.

post.description: Reads SESSION_TYPES_CONFIG_PATH, validates, and performs an atomic swap. On validation error, previous config remains in effect and 400 is returned. See §8.3.1.

400.description: Validation failed or configuration file missing

post.description: Revokes current session (or all sessions if all_sessions is true) (Server Spec v3.0.4 §8.2).
Create a new headless bot account per §8.8.1. Auth: User session only (bot tokens cannot create bots). Returns bot details and initial bot token.

400.description: Invalid display_name, pubkey, or scope requirements

post.description: Bot acknowledges receipt of a command per §8.8.21. Prevents command TTL expiry. Auth: Bot token matching target bot.
Bot sends command result to invoker (target: 'invoker') or local message to owner (target: 'owner') per §8.8.12. Auth: Bot token only.

409.description: Command not acked, result already delivered, or request ID conflict

get.description: Bot fetches its own configured settings per §8.8.14. Auth: Bot token only. Returned value_encrypted_bot encodes ephemeral_pubkey (32) || nonce (12) || ciphertext || tag (16).
Fetches bot-scoped durable events since a given bot_seq cursor. Auth: Bot token only.
Fetch bot account record including declared scopes and declarations per §8.8.2. Auth: Bot owner user session or bot token matching id.

delete.description: Delete a bot account per §8.8. Auth: Bot owner user session or bot token matching id.

patch.description: Update bot account display name or declarations per §8.8.3. Auth: Bot owner user session or bot token matching id.

400.description: Invalid display_name or top-level declarations shape

post.description: Upload or replace bot avatar image per §8.8.4. Auth: Bot owner or bot token. Body is multipart/form-data with file field.

413.description: File size exceeds effective max limit

delete.description: Remove bot avatar image per §8.8.5. Auth: Bot owner or bot token.

patch.description: Rotate bot identity, command, and MLS keys per §8.8.17. Auth: Bot owner session or bot token matching id. All three 32-byte public keys are required (partial rotation returns 400 partial_rotation_not_supported). Appends leaf to Key Transparency log.

400.description: Partial rotation or invalid key encoding

get.description: List pending or answered operator queue entries for a bot. Auth: Bot owner session, designated operator session, or bot token matching id.

404.description: Bot not found or not an operator

get.description: Fetch full operator queue entry including payload. Auth: Bot owner session, designated operator session, or bot token matching id.

404.description: Bot not found, request not found, or not an operator

post.description: Submit response to a pending operator queue entry. Auth: Bot owner session, designated operator session, or bot token matching id.

404.description: Bot not found, request not found, or not an operator

get.description: List tokens issued for a bot per §8.8.19. Auth: Bot owner session or bot token matching id. Token secret values are not returned.

post.description: Issue a new token for a bot per §8.8.18. Auth: Bot owner session or bot token matching id. Token value shown once.

delete.description: Revoke a bot token per §8.8.20. Auth: Bot owner session or bot token matching id.

get.description: Server capabilities and configuration advertisement endpoint (Server Spec v3.0.4 §8.1).
Server liveness check endpoint (Server Spec v3.0.4 §8.1).

get.summary: Current bot keys with inclusion proof
get.description: Fetches current bot identity and command keys with Merkle inclusion proof. See §8.11.2.

200.description: Bot Key Transparency entry retrieved successfully

404.description: Bot not found or Key Transparency disabled

get.description: Fetches all historical key entries for a bot ordered by leaf_index ASC without inclusion proofs. See §8.11.3.

200.description: Bot Key Transparency history retrieved successfully

404.description: Bot not found or Key Transparency disabled

get.description: Fetches current Key Transparency tree head snapshot on demand. See §8.11.4.

404.description: Snapshot not found or Key Transparency disabled

get.summary: Current user keys with inclusion proof
get.description: Fetches current user public key and Merkle inclusion proof. See §8.11.1. Note: username_token is excluded from response per §12.

200.description: User Key Transparency entry retrieved successfully

404.description: User not found or Key Transparency disabled

get.description: Server readiness check endpoint verifying DB, OPRF key, and Sockudo (Server Spec v3.0.4 §8.1).

post.description: User sends an encrypted command to a bot in a room per §8.8.11. Auth: Room member session token. Supports request_id idempotency.

403.description: Forbidden or bot not granted read_commands scope

post.description: Bot posts an encrypted message to a room per §8.8.10. Auth: Bot token matching granted bot_id with post_message scope. Ed25519 signature verified per §8.10. Supports request_id idempotency.

400.description: Invalid content_type, ciphertext, signature, or epoch out of window

get.description: List bots granted to a room per §8.8.6. Auth: Room members. Note: connected status is included ONLY if caller is the bot's owner.

post.description: Grant a bot to a room per §8.8.7. Auth: Room owner / moderator. The room bot mode (write_only, observer, member) is derived automatically from the granted scope set per §7.10.

400.description: Invalid scope or missing scope dependency

409.description: Bot already granted or room bot limit reached

delete.description: Revoke a bot grant from a room per §8.8.9. Auth: Room owner / moderator.

patch.description: Update granted scopes for a bot in a room per §8.8.8. Auth: Room owner / moderator. Mode is re-derived automatically from the new scope set per §7.10.

get.description: Server-Sent Events (SSE) stream for observer bots per §8.8.13. Auth: Bot token with read_metadata scope. Emits event types: message.new (with size_bytes), message.edited, message.deleted, room.member_added, room.member_removed, room.updated. Ciphertext and non-metadata events are omitted. Reconnection via Last-Event-ID header; buffer overflow emits 'dropped' event with count.

parameters.name: Last-Event-ID
parameters.description: Last received event ID for stream resumption

get.description: Fetch current or specific epoch publisher key for a room per §8.8.15. Auth: Room members.

404.description: Room or publisher key not found

post.description: Publish publisher key for the current epoch per §8.8.16. Auth: Human room members only (bots excluded). Signature verified per §8.10.
Queries a user by their one-way derived lookup token (Server Spec v3.0.4 §8.2, §8.2.3).

400.description: Bad request / missing or invalid token

get.description: Fetches the current authenticated user's profile and limits (Server Spec v3.0.4 §8.2, §8.2.1).

delete.description: Anonymizes and soft-deletes the current user's account and associated data (Server Spec v3.0.4 §8.2). Requires fresh session and confirmation.

patch.description: Updates the authenticated user's encrypted display name and/or profile payload (Server Spec v3.0.4 §8.2, §8.2.2).

400.description: Bad request / invalid payload or immutable field

post.description: Uploads a user avatar image as a multipart/form-data payload (Server Spec v3.0.4 §8.2, §8.2.7).

requestBody.description: Multipart avatar file and manifest metadata

400.description: Bad request / missing file or invalid manifest

get.description: Operator fetches settings for an owned bot per §8.8.14. Auth: Bot owner user session. Secret setting client values return NULL.

delete.description: Operator deletes a bot setting per §8.8.14. Auth: Bot owner user session.

patch.description: Operator writes or updates a bot setting per §8.8.14. Auth: Bot owner user session. Validates secret table rules: is_secret=true requires value_encrypted_bot and forbids value_encrypted_client; is_secret=false requires both.

400.description: Invalid setting key, client ciphertext missing/forbidden, or payload too large

get.description: Lists all registered devices for the current user (Server Spec v3.0.4 §8.2).

delete.description: Revokes a registered device for the current user (Server Spec v3.0.4 §8.2).

patch.description: Updates the encrypted name for a target device owned by the user (Server Spec v3.0.4 §8.2, §8.2.8).

400.description: Bad request / missing or invalid encrypted name

get.description: Generates and streams a ZIP archive containing the user's exported data (Server Spec v3.0.4 §8.2, §14.3).
Retrieves an encrypted preference value by key (Server Spec v3.0.4 §8.2, §8.2.8).

404.description: Preference not found or reserved key

delete.description: Deletes an encrypted preference by key (Server Spec v3.0.4 §8.2, §8.2.8).

400.description: Invalid key syntax or reserved key

patch.description: Sets or updates an encrypted preference value (Server Spec v3.0.4 §8.2, §8.2.8).

400.description: Invalid key, invalid value, or reserved key

get.description: Lists all active push subscriptions for the current user (Server Spec v3.0.4 §8.2).

post.description: Registers or updates a push notification subscription for the user (Server Spec v3.0.4 §8.2).

delete.description: Revokes a specific push subscription for the current user (Server Spec v3.0.4 §8.2).

post.description: Updates the user's read state cursor for a specified room (Server Spec v3.0.4 §8.2, §8.2.5).

400.description: Bad request / missing field or invalid message ID

patch.description: Updates the ordered list of room IDs for sidebar display (Server Spec v3.0.4 §8.2, §8.2.6).

403.description: Not a member of one or more specified rooms

get.description: Lists all active session tokens for the current user (Server Spec v3.0.4 §8.2).

delete.description: Revokes a specific session token for the current user (Server Spec v3.0.4 §8.2).

get.description: Lists starred items with optional type, room, limit, and cursor filtering (Server Spec v3.0.4 §8.2, §8.2.9).

400.description: Invalid item type or invalid cursor

post.description: Stars a message, attachment, or link item (Server Spec v3.0.4 §8.2, §8.2.9).

404.description: Room or starred item not found

delete.description: Removes a star from an item (Server Spec v3.0.4 §8.2, §8.2.9).

get.description: Fetches user-scoped state updates since a given sequence cursor (Server Spec v3.0.4 §8.2, §8.2.4).

chunk_count.description: Number of encrypted C2SP chunks. See §7.7.

chunk_size.description: Chunk size in bytes (16384 bytes). See §5.13, §7.7.

encrypted_size.description: Encrypted byte length after C2SP chunked encryption. See §7.7.

nonce_prefix.description: Hex-encoded nonce prefix for chunk counter derivation. See §7.7.

plaintext_size.description: Plaintext byte length before chunked C2SP encryption. See §7.7.

room_id.description: Optional room ID for room-scoped attachments, null for user-scoped attachments. See §7.7, §8.6.

bot_command_pubkey.description: Bot command public key, base64url encoded. Reference: §7.11

bot_identity_pubkey.description: Bot identity public key, base64url encoded. Reference: §7.11

identity_pubkey.description: Bot operator Ed25519 identity public key, base64url encoded. Reference: §7.11

bot_command_pubkey.description: Bot command public key, base64url encoded. Reference: §7.11

bot_identity_pubkey.description: Bot identity public key, base64url encoded. Reference: §7.11

identity_pubkey.description: Bot operator Ed25519 identity public key, base64url encoded. Reference: §7.11

inclusion_proof.description: Merkle inclusion proof hashes, base64url encoded.

value_encrypted_bot.description: Client-encrypted bot setting value for bot, base64url encoded. Wire shape: ephemeral_pubkey (32) || nonce (12) || ciphertext || tag (16). Reference: §7.10, §8.8.14.

value_encrypted_client.description: Client-encrypted bot setting value for operator, base64url encoded. NULL for secret settings. Reference: §6.29, §8.8.14.

suffix_count.description: Count of active domain suffixes in blocklist.

enabled.description: True if Key Transparency logging is active.

newest_leaf_added_at.description: Timestamp when newest leaf was added.

oldest_leaf_added_at.description: Timestamp when oldest leaf was added.

tree_size.description: Total number of leaves in Key Transparency log.

signature.description: Auditor signature over tree head, base64url encoded.

root_hash.description: 32-byte Merkle tree root hash, base64url encoded. Reference: §7.11
32-byte Merkle tree root hash, base64url encoded. Reference: §7.11

signature.description: Server signature over tree head, base64url encoded.

ciphertext.description: Command plaintext encrypted via X25519 ECDH to bot_command_pubkey, base64url encoded. Reference: §6.31.

ephemeral_result_pubkey.description: Client's ephemeral X25519 public key for command result decryption, base64url encoded. Reference: §6.31.

ciphertext.description: Bot message ciphertext encrypted under current epoch publisher key, base64url encoded. Wire shape: ephemeral_pubkey (32) || nonce (12) || ciphertext || tag (16). Reference: §6.33, §8.8.10.

signature.description: Ed25519 signature over room_id || epoch || content_type || ciphertext. Reference: §8.10.

bot_result_pubkey.description: Bot result X25519 public key, base64url encoded. Reference: §6.31, §8.8.12.

signature.description: Ed25519 signature over room_id || epoch || publisher_public_key. Reference: §8.10.
Ed25519 signature over room_id || epoch || publisher_public_key. Reference: §8.10.

confirm.description: Flag indicating explicit confirmation for username OPRF key rotation. Must be true.

backup_path.description: File path where previous OPRF key was backed up.

restart_required.description: True indicating server process restart is required.

rotated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when rotation took place.

users_flagged.description: Number of registered users flagged for re-registration.

session_types.description: List of active session types post-reload.

root_hash.description: 32-byte Merkle tree root hash, base64url encoded. Reference: §7.11

signature.description: Server signature over tree head, base64url encoded.

identity_pubkey.description: User Ed25519 identity public key, base64url encoded. Reference: §7.11

inclusion_proof.description: Merkle inclusion proof hashes, base64url encoded.

tags.name: Bots
tags.description: Bot account management, room grants, settings, commands, and publisher keys

tags.name: Key Transparency
tags.description: Key Transparency endpoints for users and bots
